lokele: Imi Paulo bɔkɔwa wa Mungu la Botomomu wa Yesu Masiya, eoka yokondesa lilendelu lia ebasoaomo la Mungu, la yokondesa liluwani liau lia wewe wa njasɔ ya Mungu,
english: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, 1:1 according to the faith of God’s chosen ones and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,

lokele: ko la iɛli sha liwawi lia layalaya eloatikaka Mungu lisakä ko oso wa lotango loa mbile, (Mungu aitota lolanga).
english: in hope of eternal life, which God, who can’t lie, promised before time began;

lokele: Nda lisho elienganaka, Inde loɛnɛsɛ Lioi liande ko la linangoli lia wɛndi ebosofomo ende’mi ko la isosha sha Mungu Bouwesi wasu.
english: but in his own time revealed his word in the message with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior,

lokele: Ende Tito wana wami wa wewe oyasangani lami nda lilendelu limɔi, booto la lilatemi lia Mungu Sango la Masiya Yesu ako Bouwesi wasu. Boyaeli wa Betoli oso ya Etanda ya Mungu
english: to Titus, my true child according to a common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.

lokele: Yatikak’aɛ nda bosanga wa Kulete ko la litina-li, liko mbo wenganeseke la wɛlï njasɔ ina ebimachani la mbo oteke Bekumi nda okenge la okenge kwa atelaka’mi angɛnɛ otel’aɛ ndola.
english: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you—

lokele: Boto oyati la litwanelo, oyasɔngi wali ko ɔmɔi, oyale la bana ebasoimela Yesu, ebatiwanjelomo mbo bale bifembesi la totefola;
english: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.

lokele: eoka loondu nde mbo Bokumi w’Etanda oyale kwa Bonyafala wa bofindi wa Mungu, ayaleke boto oyati la loasɔ ango lɔmɔi, ango ichocho la etenge, inga boto wa bosho nda bänä kwa boto bolola bieto wike.
english: For the overseer must be blameless, as God’s steward, not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain;

lokele: Kongo ko ayaleke oyatonyangela bɛɛnda, oyasami nde bolau, oyaluwi nde njasɔ la wɛlï, wa liengani ende bato la ende Mungu, la oyatokakalesa botema wande angɛnɛ;
english: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled,

lokele: boto oyatokɔkɔmɛlɛ liekesi lia wewe elisoimel’iso mbo akɔkɔlɛkɛ, inde angɛnɛ, ndoekekesa basi liekesi eliengani la ndotombola bato ebatotefokola liao.
english: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.

lokele: Eoka eba totefola la beongaonga la belimbake bende wike, asa kɔni ebasoimela liteni lia totombe.
english: For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,

lokele: Loengani nde mbo balinjomoko bɛnɔkɔ eoka basoeyaeyesa befindi bitotina bimɔi ani asoekekes’iyo liekesi eliti lau l’isosha shoekesa, mbo bɔlɛkɛ bieto kongo.
english: whose mouths must be stopped: men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest gain’s sake.

lokele: Ɔmɔi wau angɛnɛ ako bɔtɔndɔli wau loonga mbo— Eba Kulete bende bato ba nanga, nyama ibe, bafofa bieka eba bowandu ko mbile bitotina.
english: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”

lokele: Liölo-li liande lile ngo ko wewe; eokao fak’iyo liɛngɔ liwau mbo bakɔkɔmɛkɛ nda lilendelu lilau,
english: This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,

lokele: la mbo batalaila bishä ya BaYuda la baiti ba bato ebasolota mboka ya wewe.
english: not paying attention to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.

lokele: Ende ebasotana betema, bitotina bisosäsa la botanu, kongo ko ende bato ba bɔwɛwɛ la ebati la lilendelu, ambo loasɔ ango lɔmɔi loti lotanu, nde baenyeli bau la bienyelo yau bile la bɔwɛwɛ.
english: To the pure, all things are pure, but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.

lokele: Basoaolaka mbo basoluwa Mungu, kongo ko batoangany’Inde ko la bekeeli yau, bende bato ba efu, ba litefoli la basoomekelo bakuwa balau batotina.
english: They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.

lokele: Nde aɛ angɛnɛ, Tito, nda liekesi, ongaka lau ko njasɔ ebisoondo liekesi lilau;
english: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,

lokele: mbo biange bitolome bayaleke la boyaeli wa wɛlï la liengani lia biuwa, la bɔkɔkɔmu nda lilendelu la losamɔ la bofiili.
english: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance,

lokele: Ekesaka biange bitomali mbo bayalek’imɔ la boyaeli ewengani l’ebatokuwela Mungu, angotomwatomwa, angowaka bänä;
english: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,

lokele: kangä ebatoekesa njasɔ bilau mbo bakɔsɔlɛkɛ besanga la baseka la wɛlï mbo basameke balome bau la bana bau,
english: that they may train the young wives to love their husbands, to love their children,

lokele: ndoluwa njasɔ la wɛlï ndoyalaka la limama, ndokelaka bakuwa ba ndakɔ, ndoyala la booto, la ndolitesa balome bau, mbo lina la lioi lia Mungu litatomo bɔkɛcha.
english: to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God’s word may not be blasphemed.

lokele: Tosenge tooku ko ongoma, fumbesaka iyo mbo bayaleke la boyaeli wa wɛlï;
english: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.

lokele: nda njasɔ bitotina, aɛ angɛnɛ yalaka etichelo ya bekeeli ilau, la nda liekesi la momongo la boyaeli, l’angwɛnɛ isɛkɛsi,
english: In all things show yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, show integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,

lokele: kangä la liekesi eliti liotombolomo eoka liengani la olau, mbo wiyani laɛ okeke sɔni eoka atioshe lioi libe lioonga loasɔ loasu.
english: and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.

lokele: Ekesaka bɛkɔwa ndolitesa bangɛnɛ bau mbo baomalesek’iyo nda njasɔ bitotina, angofenyana lau tofenya,
english: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,

lokele: angoiya bokwangä; kangä ndɔɛnɛsɛ bangɛnɛ bau lotimbana lolendelomo la wɛli mbo baɔlɛsɛkɛ liekesi lia Mungu Bouwesi wasu ko lokuku lolau nda njasɔ bitotina.
english: not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.

lokele: Eoka booto wa Mungu bosɔɛnɛlɛ ndoeshela bato batotina liuwesi,
english: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,

lokele: la bosoekekes’iso ndotika lisakä liofekaka njasɔ ebiti ya Mungu, la yɛmɛ ya wenda-bo, kangä ndoyalaka la boyaeli ewengani la lilendelu lia njasɔ ya Mungu nda mbile-ye ya kwani,
english: instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;

lokele: ani tokoumbakela la iɛli sha lokemo shasu siko lɔɛnɛlɔ loa tala ya Mungu ofi la Bouwesi wasu ako Masiya Yesu,
english: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,

lokele: oyafak’Inde angɛnɛ eoka yasu mbo aendolek’iso nda njasɔ ibe bitotina la mbo ataneseleke tukela ya bato boomana lande bako ebatofumbaka ndokelaka bekeeli bilau.
english: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.

lokele: Taka boeki wa bakakanelo-ba, la linangoli la liimi la isosha sitotina la boto angɔmɔi ataoly’aɛ.
english: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no one despise you.

lokele: Enyelesak’iyo mbo baliteseke bɛkɔta l’ebale l’isosha likolo liau, kuliaka baiti bau, la umamaka okela bakuwa balau batotina,
english: Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,

lokele: la mbo batatɔngɔ boto angɔmɔi, batawesana, kangä mbo bayaleke la bɔfɔɔmu ani batoyalana la batu batotina la bɔɔngu.
english: to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.

lokele: Osooso iso nd’ayalaka imɔ ko bibebe, totefola, twalimbokomöko nda loeyaeyo, twalitesaka yɛmɛ ibe la bamɛngɔ ba bɛfɔnɔ wike, twatimbanaka nda bobe la luno, twaiyomoko la basi la twaiyanak’imɔ;
english: For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

lokele: kongo ko ɛnɛlɛkɛ̈ to booto bofi la losamɔ lofi loa Mungu Bouwesi wasu,
english: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,

lokele: Inde louwes’iso, inga eoka ya bekeeli ya liengani eyakelak’iso, kangä ko l’eoka ya booto wande angɛnɛ, Inde louwes’iso ko la lisooli la liotomu liyai eliafomoko iso la Bolimo Botanu,
english: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,

lokele: oyawɛlɛkɛmɛ end’iso ko l’eoka ya Yesu Masiya Bouwesi wasu,
english: whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior;

lokele: litina mbo toenganesomoko ko la booto wande, la tosangoleke botiko wa iɛli sha loiko loa layalaya.
english: that being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

lokele: Liölo-li lile wewe la isangi nde mbo wekesek’iyo mbo ebasolendelo Mungu batimbaneke la wɛli nda bakuwa balau, ongoma lole lolau la lotosungaka bato finɛ.
english: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you insist confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;

lokele: Kongo ko kufaka otakana fee litela, ango ko loasɔ loa tunya ya fɛto ya oso, ango ko loasɔ loa bosho wa Bikela eoka fee bina bitisung’iso la bile ko beongaonga wawa.
english: but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

lokele: Sɛnyanaka la boto oyatolɛmbɛ ko ndokomya njasɔ ko inde angɛnɛ, ani osotaf’inde boimo ɔmɔi ango imbale;
english: Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning,

lokele: luwaka mbo bɔfɔnɔ-bo wa boto asofenya ebisomel’iso la batwanelo, la asof’inde angɛnɛ se. Wɛndi la liseeli lia losilo loa lokasa
english: knowing that such a one is perverted and sinful, being self-condemned.

lokele: Eyakatomeleke’mi Alutema, ango ko Tukiko end’aɛ, umamaka oya ende’mi nda bokenge wa Nikopoli, eoka isosanga ndokayalaka omao nda tengai ya bondiya.
english: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.

lokele: Kotaka sumbu ndokɛsɛ Sena oyale ikomya, la Apolo, nda lɔkɛndɔ loau la mbo bataomelo yeka.
english: Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.

lokele: Bato ebasu imɔ bekeke ndokelaka bakuwa balau bosilesa beeno yau mbo batalengeela bieka.
english: Let our people also learn to maintain good works to meet necessary needs, that they may not be unfruitful.

lokele: Batotina ebale ono amamwito lami basoseelak’aɛ; seelaka eba Etanda ebasami nd’iso. Booto wa Mungu boyaleke lanu yaatotina.
english: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
